body:
Hi @zackify,

As I mentioned here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1967 it should work to read Configure props from the search state only when mounting a component, it's just that its needs further development and architecture. But be sure we are going to plan this.

In the mean time, can you tell me if reading the search state on your side and pass the right props to the Configure widget can work? I did a little geo search recipe illustrating it here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/v2/packages/react-instantsearch/examples/geo-search

Thanks :)
